description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes for the 3GPP TS ASN1 NRPPA protocol, including message types, procedures, and object sets related to NRPPAs.

classes.name: nr_ppa_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Object set of NRPPA elementary procedures, including various message types and procedure codes.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Sequence representing an initiating message with procedure code, transaction ID, and procedure content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Sequence representing a successful response message with procedure code, transaction ID, and outcome content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Sequence representing an unsuccessful response message with procedure code, transaction ID, and outcome content.

classes.name: nr_ppa_pdu_c
classes.description: Choice type representing the NRPPA Protocol Data Unit, which can be an init message, successful outcome, or unsuccessful outcome.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the procedure type for the message.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
